research_conflict_turns.create_table:
CREATE TABLE research_conflict_turns (
	step_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	operation_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	execution_snapshot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_by_attempt_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	phase VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	request_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_json JSONB NOT NULL, 
	result_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	result_json JSONB, 
	PRIMARY KEY (step_id, operation_number), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_conflict_operation_bound CHECK (operation_number >= 0 AND operation_number < 13), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_conflict_operation_status CHECK (status IN ('started','succeeded')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_conflict_operation_phase CHECK (phase IN ('inspect','search','verify','critic','finish')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(step_id) REFERENCES research_steps (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(execution_snapshot_id) REFERENCES research_execution_snapshots (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_attempt_id) REFERENCES research_step_attempts (id)
)
